metadata.name: CreateSecondaryCard
metadata.description: Use this API to create a secondary or virtual card in a single step. Certain information is required depending upon the card type, such as cardholder details, a shipping address, and card expiry date (if applicable).

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account Number of the cardholder. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 2000000000000396893 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: Title
request_fields.description: Title for the customer Valid Values:  Refer Appendix Section : Title Values Example: Mr. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: Cardholder First Name Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,special characters ( !@#$%^*()_+=-.) and Ampersand Example: Andrew Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MiddleName
request_fields.description: Cardholder Middle Name Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,special characters ( !@#$%^*()_+=-.) and Ampersand Example: Charles Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Cardholder Last Name Valid values: A-Z,a-z,special characters ( !@#$%^*()_+=-.) and Ampersand Example: Hudson Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: DOB
request_fields.description: Date of Birth of cardholder Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values: 0-9 Example:- 03/26/1986

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Address Line 1 of the Cardholder Valid values : A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 15 Penang Street Point Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Address Line 2 of the Cardholder Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 mecca way Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: City
request_fields.description: Cardholder's City of residence Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: Country
request_fields.description: Two Character Country Code Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Refer Appendix section : Country Code Values Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder Postal Code of Residence Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: State
request_fields.description: Cardholder State of residence Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: GA Please refer Appendix Section : State Codes (US) Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: HomePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Home Phone Number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9812338769 Condition: It is Mandatory when Card Account Parameters is Set as Yes on Product. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder  Work Phone Number Valid values:0-9 Example:9632581470 Condition:If validation parameter set on product as Work Phone) Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: MobilePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder's Mobile Phone Number Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9876543210 Condition:If validation parameter set on product as Work Phone) Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: EmailID
request_fields.description: E Mail Address 1 of Cardholder Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9. Example: [email protected] Condition: If validation parameter set on the product for Primary Email Address then it will be mandatory. Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: SocialSecurityNumber
request_fields.description: Social Security Number of Cardholder Valid Values:0-9 Example:123456789 Condition:At least one of SocialSecurityNumber, TaxID or IDName field should be passed in the input as Identification details Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: IDNumber
request_fields.description: Last 4 Digits of Primary ID Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 4586 Allowable Values: 18

request_fields.name: MotherMaidenName
request_fields.description: Mother’s Maiden Name Valid Values: A-Z,a-z Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: IDTypeCode
request_fields.description: Identification Type Code Valid Values: 02- Driver’s license 03- Matricular 04- Passport 05- Visa 06- Green Card 07- State ID 08- Military ID 09- Voters Registration Card 10- government ID 11- Tax identification number 12 - Cedula ID Example:05 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: IDIssueDate
request_fields.description: ID Issue Date Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values:0-9 Example: 03/26/1998 Condition: This field is mandatory when IDTypeCode is "2".

request_fields.name: IDExpirationDate
request_fields.description: Expiration date of ID. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values:0-9 Example:03/26/1998

request_fields.name: IDIssueState
request_fields.description: ID Issue State Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example:GA Refer Appendix section : State Codes (US) Condition: This field is mandatory when IDIssuingAuthority = 'US',IDTypeCode = '07' or IDTypeCode='02'. Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: NameOnCard
request_fields.description: Name to be Embossed on Card Valid values are A-Z, a-z, and all special characters Example: Hudson M Charles Allowable Values: 28

request_fields.name: EmbossingLine4
request_fields.description: Embossing line4. Allowable Values: 26

request_fields.name: ClientID
request_fields.description: Indicate Client Id and echo in embossing file Valid Values: 1422245 Format:XXXXX Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: VirtualCardExpiryOption
request_fields.description: Virtual Card Expiry Option Valid values are 0,1,2 0 = Card will expire after n number of transaction 1 = Card will expire  after n number of days/hour/Minutes/Month/Weeks/years 2 = Card will expire on particular  date Condition : SecondaryCardType = 1 then this options will be applicable. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LanguageIndicator
request_fields.description: Language Indicator Valid Values:A-Z,a-z. Example: en, where en represents 'English' Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: SecondaryCardType
request_fields.description: Type of secondary card Valid Values:0-2 0 = Regular Card 1 = Virtual Card 2 = Family Card Example: 0 (Regular Card) Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: IssuanceCardType
request_fields.description: Secondary card  type Valid Values : Blank = New card created (Default value) 2 = Issue from Inventory (Future use) Example : 2

request_fields.name: SecondaryCardNumber
request_fields.description: Card number of the card  from inventory Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition: This field is mandatory when IssuanceCardType is 2(Issue from Inventory). Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: SecondaryProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy number of the card  from inventory Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition: This field is mandatory when IssuanceCardType is 2(Issue from Inventory). Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: VirtualCardLimit
request_fields.description: Virtual Card Limit allocates for Virtual Card it can be greater than available balance of primary card but can not be greater than the primary card limit which is set on product. Condition : SecondaryCardType = 1 then this options will be applicable Example 100,200 When SecondaryCardType = 2, then it will display the Family Card Usage Limit Allowable Values: 11

request_fields.name: VirtualCardResetAllow
request_fields.description: Virtual Card Reset Allowed or not Valid Values  0:Yes, 1 : No Example : 1 Condition: This field is mandatory when SecondaryCardType is 1(Virtual Card). Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: VirtualCardExpiresNumberOfTransaction
request_fields.description: Number of transaction allowed from the virtual card Valid Values : 0-9 Example : 10 Condition : Mandatory When VirtualCardExpiryOption = 0 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: VirtualCardExpiryDuration
request_fields.description: Duration Valid Values are 0 = Minutes 1 = Hour 2 = Day 3 = Week 4 = Month 5 = Year Example : 3 Condition:Mandatory  When VirtualCardExpiryOption is 1 Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: VirtualCardExpiresExpiryDate
request_fields.description: Date of expiration for virtual card Format: mmddyyyy Condition : Mandatory When VirtualCardExpiryOption is 2. Allowable Values: 8

request_fields.name: VirtualCardExpiryValue
request_fields.description: Duration Valid Values : 1-999 Condition: Mandatory When VirtualCardExpiryOption = 1 Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: IDIssuingAuthority
request_fields.description: ID Issuing Authority (country) Condition : This field is mandatory when IDName is provided. Example : AE =  United Arab Emirates Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: CIPCheck
request_fields.description: CIP check for secondary card Should be performed or not. Valid Values: 0 (No) 1 (Yes) Condition: 1 should only be accepted when on product 'CIP/LN checkfor Secondary Card' is YES. By default it should go as 1 (Yes) Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RelationwithPrimary
request_fields.description: RelationwithPrimary card holder Valid Values: 0=Wife, 1=Husband, 2=Son, 3=Daughter, 4=Brother, 5=Sister, 6=Father, 7=Mother, 8=Partner, 9=Other. Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: CreateCIPFailedAccount
request_fields.description: Action to be taken when CIP check is failed Possible value are 'Y' and 'N' Y- Create Account N- Do not create Account Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: LinkWithExistingCustomer
request_fields.description: To link new account with existing customer using customer ID Valid Values: 0 = No(default) and 1 = Yes Format: x Example: 0=No,

request_fields.name: CustomerID
request_fields.description: Unique ID associated with Customer Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example: abc2123 Condition: Mandatory when 'Link With Existing Customer' = Yes Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: IsCardMasked
request_fields.description: Flag to indicate Card Number should be returned in masked form or in clear form. Valid Values: 0= Clear Card Number in Response. 1= Masked Card Number in Response. 2= No Card Number in Response. Note : Default value is 1 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: HoldEmbossing
request_fields.description: Tag to decide physical card or virtual card by holding embossing file. Valid Values: 0 - No (Physical card) 1 - Yes (Virtual card)

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account Number of the cardholder. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 2000000000000396893

children.name: FirstName
children.description: Cardholder First Name Valid Values: A-Z, a-z Example: Andrew

children.name: LastName
children.description: Cardholder Last Name Valid values:A-Z, a-z Example: Hudson

children.name: CardStatus
children.description: Card Plastic Status Example : New Card Pending Activation

children.name: ValidFrom
children.description: Card Creation Date of requested card. Format:MM/YY Example:03/21

children.name: ValidTo
children.description: Card Expiration Date of requested card. Format:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/01/2022

children.name: CurrentCardBalance
children.description: Current Balance of Account Example: 5425.00

children.name: ActivationRequired
children.description: Activation required or not. Valid Values : Yes , No Example : Yes

children.name: NameOnCard
children.description: Name to be Embossed on Card Valid values are A-Z, a-z, 0-9. Example: Hudson M Charles

children.name: ProxyNumber
children.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

children.name: CloseDate
children.description: Close or cancellation Date of requested card. Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example: 2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: CardExpirationDate
children.description: Expiration Date of the card. Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 2021-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: CardExpirationDateISO
children.description: Expiration Date of created card as per ISO format. Format: MMYY Example: 0121

children.name: CustomerID
children.description: Unique ID linked to the customer Valid Values:0-9 Example: 3212212

children.name: SecondaryCardType
children.description: Type of secondary card Valid Values:0-2 0 = Regular Card 1 = Virtual Card 2 = Family Card Example: 0 (Regular Card)

children.name: CardGeneratedStatus
children.description: Generated Status of Card Example :New Card Pending Activation

children.name: CVC
children.description: Three digit printed on  the back of  the card. Valid Values - 0-9 Example: 213

children.name: LNResultsGroup
children.description: LNResultsGroup

children.name: LexNexList
children.description: This will have RiskCodes in Array

children.name: RiskCodes
children.description: Risk Codes triggered on the card Example: 28 Unable to verify date-of-birth

children.name: CVICheckValue
children.description: score of Comprehensive Verification Index Example: 0,10,20

children.name: NASCheckValue
children.description: Name Address SSN (NAS) Check tag shows Reason Codes triggered on the card Example: 10 Input First name, Address, and SSN matched

children.name: LexNexInquiryDate
children.description: Lexis Nexis Inquiry Date Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: RequestedProxyNumber
children.description: Proxy number of the card which requested the secondary card Valid values:0-9 Example:100556

children.name: CardNumber
children.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001

children.name: OFACResultsGroup
children.description: OFACResultsGroup

children.name: OFACInquiryDate
children.description: OFAC Inquiry Date Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: OFACScore
children.description: Score received after OFAC Checks. Example : 2

children.name: SDNEntry1
children.description: Value imposed to an Account after OFAC Check via third party Example:85

children.name: SDNEntry4
children.description: Value imposed to an Account after OFAC Check via third party Example:85

children.name: SDNEntry5
children.description: Value imposed to an Account after OFAC Check via third party Example:85

children.name: PlasticCode
children.description: Plastic Code of Card Valid Values: a to z, A to Z, 0 to 9 Example:- Chicksaw Nation Grant Card - Clothing (50)
